raw_segments.text: Servant, thus Brutus did my master bid me kneel, thus did Mark Antony bid me fall down,
and being prostrate thus he bade me say, Brutus is noble, wise, valiant, and honest.
Caesar was mighty, bold, royal, and loving, say I love Brutus and I honor him, say I feared
Caesar honored him and loved him.
If Brutus will vouch safe that Antony may safely come to him, and be resolved how Caesar
hath deserved to lie in death, Mark Antony shall not love Caesar dead so well as Brutus
living, but will follow the fortunes and affairs of noble Brutus thorough the hazards of this
untraud state with all true faith.
